We employed tandem mass tag (TMT)-based labeling technology coupled with anti-phosphotyrosine antibody-based enrichment approach to identify differentially phosphorylated proteins between normal oral keratinocyte OKF6/TERT1, and a panel of HNSCC cell lines (JHU-O11, JHU-O22, JHU-O28, JHU-O29, FaDu and CAL 27)
